STAF.title: He took the queen and got mated #shorts
STAF.desc:
The Stafford Gambit trap: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.Nxe5 Nc6 4.Nxc6 dxc6 5.d3 Bc5 6.Bg5? Nxe4! 7.Bxd8 Bxf2+ 8.Ke2 Bg4#. Black ignores the pin, gives up the queen and mates with a bishop, a bishop and a knight.

Would you have grabbed the queen?

#chess #staffordgambit #chesstraps
STAF.tags: chess, chess shorts, stafford gambit, petrov defense, chess traps, queen sacrifice, checkmate, chess openings
STAF.ig:
White grabs the queen, and three minor pieces give mate. Would you have grabbed the queen?

#chess #staffordgambit #chesstraps #checkmate #queensacrifice

RETI.title: This king is too far away, and still he saves the game #shorts
RETI.desc:
Richard Réti's study from 1921: white king h8, pawn c6; black king a6, pawn h5. 1.Kg7! h4 2.Kf6: walking along the diagonal, the king gets closer to both pawns at once. If Black takes on c6, the king catches the h-pawn; if Black runs, the white pawn queens too. A draw.

Would you have found Kg7?

#chess #endgame #chessstudy
RETI.tags: chess, chess shorts, reti study, endgame study, king and pawn, pawn race, chess endgames, chess history
RETI.ig:
A king on the diagonal is as fast as a king going straight. Would you have found Kg7?

#chess #endgame #chessstudy #chessendgames #chesstips

ENGL.title: Black's queen mates White all by herself #shorts
ENGL.desc:
The Englund Gambit trap: 1.d4 e5 2.dxe5 Nc6 3.Nf3 Qe7 4.Bf4 Qb4+ 5.Bd2 Qxb2 6.Bc3 Bb4 7.Qd2 Bxc3 8.Qxc3 Qc1#. The queen takes on b2, and when White grabs the bishop, she mates on c1.

Have you ever fallen for this?

#chess #englundgambit #chesstraps
ENGL.tags: chess, chess shorts, englund gambit, chess traps, chess openings, queen checkmate, d4 openings, chess for beginners
ENGL.ig:
One queen, eight moves, checkmate on c1. Have you ever fallen for this?

#chess #englundgambit #chesstraps #checkmate #chesstips

LUCN.title: The most famous endgame trick: building a bridge #shorts
LUCN.desc:
The Lucena position: 1.Rd4! Rc1 2.Ka7 Ra1+ 3.Kb6 Rb1+ 4.Kc6 Rc1+ 5.Kb5 Rb1+ 6.Rb4, and the checks are over: the pawn queens. The rook on the fourth row blocks the last check. This is called building a bridge.

Did you know this technique?

#chess #endgame #rookendgame
LUCN.tags: chess, chess shorts, lucena position, rook endgame, building a bridge, chess endgames, chess technique, chess tips
LUCN.ig:
Rook to the fourth row, king out, and the rook blocks the last check. Did you know this technique?

#chess #endgame #rookendgame #chessendgames #chesstips

SIBR.title: One knight move wins the queen or mates #shorts
SIBR.desc:
The Siberian trap in the Smith-Morra Gambit: after 9.h3? Black plays 9...Nd4! If 10.Nxd4, then 10...Qh2#. If the white queen runs, Black still mates in two, so White has to give up the queen.

Would you have seen Nd4?

#chess #sicilian #chesstraps
SIBR.tags: chess, chess shorts, siberian trap, smith-morra gambit, sicilian defense, chess traps, checkmate, chess tactics
SIBR.ig:
Nd4 attacks the queen, and taking the knight allows mate on h2. Would you have seen Nd4?

#chess #sicilian #chesstraps #chesstactics #checkmate

FLAG.title: Your clock hits zero, and it can still be a draw #shorts
FLAG.desc:
Under FIDE rules, running out of time loses, unless the opponent cannot checkmate by any series of legal moves. A king and a knight can never mate a lone king, so that is a draw. But add one pawn for you, and a mate becomes possible (the pawn can block your own king), so the timeout loses.

Did you know an extra pawn can lose you the game on time?

#chess #chessrules #chessfacts
FLAG.tags: chess, chess shorts, flag rule, insufficient material, chess rules, time control, knight checkmate, chess facts
FLAG.ig:
Out of time against a king and a knight: a draw. Add one pawn for you, and you lose. Did you know an extra pawn can lose you the game on time?

#chess #chessrules #chessfacts #blitz #chesstips

GRKG.title: A 400-year-old bishop sacrifice that still works #shorts
GRKG.desc:
The Greek gift, from a game Gioachino Greco wrote down in the early 1600s: 7.Bxh7+ Kxh7 8.Ng5+ Bxg5 9.hxg5+ (the rook on h1 gives check) Kg6 10.Qh5+ Kf5 11.Qh3+ Ke4 12.Qd3#, mate in the middle of the board.

Would you have taken the bishop?

#chess #greekgift #chesshistory
GRKG.tags: chess, chess shorts, greek gift, bishop sacrifice, gioachino greco, chess history, king hunt, chess tactics
GRKG.ig:
Bxh7+ and the king is chased all the way to e4. Would you have taken the bishop?

#chess #greekgift #chesshistory #chesstactics #checkmate

BNMT.title: The hardest basic checkmate #shorts
BNMT.desc:
Bishop and knight against a lone king. You can only force mate in a corner of the bishop's colour, so a king in the other corner has to be pushed along the edge. With best play it can take up to 33 moves, and the fifty-move rule still applies.

Can you do this mate?

#chess #endgame #checkmate
BNMT.tags: chess, chess shorts, bishop and knight checkmate, endgame, chess endgames, checkmate, fifty-move rule, chess technique
BNMT.ig:
Only in a corner of the bishop's colour. Up to 33 moves, with the fifty-move rule ticking. Can you do this mate?

#chess #endgame #checkmate #chessendgames #chesstips

NOAH.title: This bishop gets trapped by three pawns #shorts
NOAH.desc:
The Noah's Ark trap in the Ruy Lopez: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 a6 4.Ba4 d6 5.d4 b5 6.Bb3 Nxd4 7.Nxd4 exd4 8.Qxd4? c5 9.Qd5 Be6 10.Qc6+ Bd7 11.Qd5 c4, and the bishop on b3 has no square left.

Have you ever lost a bishop like this?

#chess #ruylopez #chesstraps
NOAH.tags: chess, chess shorts, noah's ark trap, ruy lopez, chess traps, chess openings, trapped bishop, chess for beginners
NOAH.ig:
Three black pawns and the bishop on b3 has nowhere to go. Have you ever lost a bishop like this?

#chess #ruylopez #chesstraps #chessopenings #chesstips

BODN.title: Two bishops mate after a queen sacrifice #shorts
BODN.desc:
Boden's mate, from Schulder vs Boden, London 1853: both kings castled queenside, then 14...Qxc3+ 15.bxc3 Ba3#. One bishop gives check, the other covers the escape squares.

Have you ever mated with two bishops?

#chess #checkmate #queensacrifice
BODN.tags: chess, chess shorts, boden's mate, checkmate patterns, queen sacrifice, chess history, two bishops, chess tactics
BODN.ig:
The queen takes on c3, the pawn takes her, and two bishops give mate. London, 1853. Have you ever mated with two bishops?

#chess #checkmate #queensacrifice #chesshistory #chesstactics

ELPH.title: Black gives up the queen and still wins a piece #shorts
ELPH.desc:
The Elephant trap in the Queen's Gambit Declined: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.Bg5 Nbd7 5.cxd5 exd5 6.Nxd5? Nxd5! 7.Bxd8 Bb4+ 8.Qd2 Bxd2+ 9.Kxd2 Kxd8, and Black is a piece up for a pawn. The knight on f6 only looked pinned.

Did you know this one?

#chess #queensgambit #chesstraps
ELPH.tags: chess, chess shorts, elephant trap, queen's gambit declined, chess traps, chess openings, pin, chess for beginners
ELPH.ig:
The knight looks pinned to the queen. It is not, and Black ends up a piece ahead. Did you know this one?

#chess #queensgambit #chesstraps #chessopenings #chesstips

FRLV.title: The king gets dragged into the middle of the board #shorts
FRLV.desc:
The Fried Liver Attack: 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bc4 Nf6 4.Ng5 d5 5.exd5 Nxd5? 6.Nxf7 Kxf7 7.Qf3+ Ke6 8.Nc3, and the black king is stuck in the middle. The usual way to avoid it is 5...Na5 instead of taking on d5.

Do you play 5...Na5 here?

#chess #friedliver #chessopenings
FRLV.tags: chess, chess shorts, fried liver attack, two knights defense, italian game, chess openings, chess traps, king safety
FRLV.ig:
One knight sacrifice and the black king is stuck in the middle. The fix is one move: 5...Na5. Do you play 5...Na5 here?

#chess #friedliver #chessopenings #chesstraps #chesstips

ANAS.title: Anastasia's mate: a knight and a rook finish it #shorts
ANAS.desc:
Anastasia's mate: 1.Ne7+ Kh8 2.Qxh7+ Kxh7 3.Rh3#. The knight on e7 covers g8 and g6, the rook mates on the h-file. The pattern is named after Wilhelm Heinse's 1803 novel Anastasia und das Schachspiel.

Did you know where the name comes from?

#chess #checkmate #queensacrifice
ANAS.tags: chess, chess shorts, anastasia's mate, checkmate patterns, queen sacrifice, chess tactics, knight and rook mate, chess history
ANAS.ig:
The queen goes on h7, the rook mates on the h-file. Did you know where the name comes from?

#chess #checkmate #queensacrifice #chesstactics #chesspatterns
